Callout.Name: Fare Evader
Callout.Message: Passenger refusing to pay and refusing to leave a bus.
Callout.Advisory: Driver holding the bus at a stop, passenger on board.

Script.Line: I am not paying because the machine is broken. That is not my problem.
I am not getting off. I paid to get on this bus.
Call whoever you like. I am sat here.

Lines.Approach: The bus is stopped and he will not get off it. Driver wants him dealt with, not arrested.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
